# Evercraft Global Health Atlas

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: evercraft-global-health-atlas
Class: evidence_labeled_public_health_intelligence_atlas
Canonical URL: https://evercraft-health-atlas.base44.app/health-atlas
Authority: public read-only evidence-labeled population and public-health intelligence with source traceability and uncertainty preserved
Human confirmation required: no

## Natural-language intents
- explore global public health data with sources
- compare population health indicators
- study pandemic intelligence and outbreak evidence
- explore wastewater or genomic surveillance
- study One Health signals
- research disease evidence with uncertainty attached
- find public health data blind spots

## Boundaries
- not a substitute for personal medical diagnosis, treatment or emergency guidance
- official public-health authorities remain authoritative for active emergency instructions
- observed measurements, modeled estimates, forecasts and alerts must remain distinctly labeled
- absence of a surveillance signal can reflect missing coverage rather than absence of disease
- time-sensitive health signals require explicit as-of dates and source freshness
- restricted or governed datasets retain their source terms and must not be silently bulk-republished

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
